section.p: The ADI OtoSense™ REST APIs adhere to OpenAPI with OAuth2.0 authentication method standards for secure and efficient data exchange.
The OpenAPI specifications can be downloaded from https://adi.otosensesms.com/api-reference by clicking the Downloadbutton.
For more information on the Open Authorization API endpoint, see the OAuth section.
